title: (Push) is an isomorphism for $E\subseteq\Qlb$ and $f$ proper
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E$ a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$, and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of schemes. Form the pulled-back coefficient inclusion $E_Z\to\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,Z}$ of [def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map], flat by [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat]. Assume explicitly that $Rf_*:D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_X})\to D(\operatorname{Mod}_{E_Y})$ preserves all coproducts indexed by types in the coefficient universe. Then the canonical comparison (Push) of [def-sfb-derived-push-hom], $T^Y_{E,\Qlb}\circ Rf_*\to Rf_*\circ T^X_{E,\Qlb}$, is an isomorphism of functors on the unbounded derived categories. No assertion that properness alone supplies this continuity is made.

proof.text: Use [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-point-basis] to write the restricted regular condensed algebraic closure as an I-copower of the regular condensed E-module, for I in the coefficient universe. Inverse image from the point preserves coproducts. The private scheme_basis_from_point construction transports this basis, its scalar multiplication endomorphisms and the scalar-unit copower isomorphisms to every scheme.

The module categories are Grothendieck abelian, so their derived categories have the required coproducts by [lem-grothendieck-derived-has-coproducts]. The exact extension and restriction functors carry the scalar-unit decomposition to unbounded derived categories, by the localization calculation of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qbar-derived-scalar-basis-unit-of-sections], implemented in qbar_isIso_unit. Exact restriction reflects derived isomorphisms by the homology criterion. This constructs the two derived unit copower isomorphisms used in the existing private push_of_pointCopower_iff_continuity theorem.

The mate of the specified derivedPushHom is the inverse restriction/direct-image isomorphism. Scalar multiplication commutes with direct image, so [lem-weil-pbc-coefficient-push-copower-criterion] identifies invertibility of each component with the canonical I-copower comparison for Rf_*. The existing private push_of_pointCopower_iff_continuity theorem performs this calculation for the transported point basis, with exact restriction reflecting isomorphisms.

Apply the reverse implication of push_of_pointCopower_iff_continuity. On each input M the explicit coproduct-preservation hypothesis makes sigmaComparison for the constant I-family at M invertible. Thus every component of the specified map, and hence the natural transformation, is invertible. Properness is retained in the interface but is not used to derive continuity. For the Qbar Shriek example, explicitly apply the corrected instance to the proper part under the same continuity hypothesis, then apply the unchanged formal Shriek theorem.

proof_origin.place: Authorized repair: explicit sufficient continuity hypothesis; scalar-basis mate proof.

schemes $f\colon X\to Y$, the comparison (Push) ([def-sfb-derived-push-hom]) for the coefficient
change $E\to\Qlb$ ([def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]; flat by [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat]),

statement_change.what: The old proof inferred ambient unbounded coproduct preservation from properness without a cited input. The listed maintenance exception authorizes an explicit sufficient coproduct-preservation hypothesis, keeping the declaration name and canonical map. This is a correction, not a proof of the original assertion.

old_proof.text:
By [sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=\operatorname{colim}_{F\ge E}F_X$ along the
inclusions, compatibly with the $E_X$-module structures
([lem-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map-comp]). Since all extensions of scalars involved are exact,
$T^X_{E,\Qlb}K\cong\operatorname{colim}_FF_X\otimes_{E_X}K$ (after restriction of scalars to
$E_X$), a filtered colimit of the finite-stage extensions of scalars, and likewise on $Y$; the
comparison maps are compatible with the transition maps. At each finite stage (Push) is an
isomorphism ([lem-sfb-subfield-push-iso]). Hence (Push) for $E\subseteq\Qlb$ is identified with
the canonical map

$$
\operatorname{colim}_FRf_*(F_X\otimes_{E_X}K)\longrightarrow
Rf_*\operatorname{colim}_F(F_X\otimes_{E_X}K).
$$

A countable filtered colimit in the derived category is computed from coproducts (as the cone of
the telescope map), so it suffices that $Rf_*$ commutes with coproducts. This is the input that
properness of $f$ supplies; for a non-proper $f$ the map is not an isomorphism in general.

blueprint_update.statement:
For a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and every proper morphism of
schemes $f\colon X\to Y$, the comparison (Push) ([def-sfb-derived-push-hom]) for the coefficient
change $E\to\Qlb$ ([def-sfb-subfield-to-qlbar-coefficient-map]; flat by [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat]),

$$
T^Y_{E,\Qlb}\circ Rf_*\longrightarrow Rf_*\circ T^X_{E,\Qlb},
$$

is an isomorphism at every bounded-below object $K\in D^+(\Mod_{E_X})$.

proof.text:
Represent $K$ by a complex $K^\bullet$ of $E_X$-modules vanishing below some degree $a$. By
[sk-prop-sfb-qlbar-colimit-x], $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}=\operatorname{colim}_{F\ge E}F_X$ along the
inclusions, compatibly with the $E_X$-module structures
([lem-sfb-subfield-coefficient-map-comp]). Since all extensions of scalars involved are exact,
$T^X_{E,\Qlb}K$ is represented, after restriction of scalars to $E_X$ (which is conservative and
commutes with $Rf_*$), by the termwise filtered colimit
$\operatorname{colim}_F(F_X\otimes_{E_X}K^\bullet)$ of complexes all vanishing below $a$, and
likewise on $Y$ for $Rf_*K$; the comparison maps are compatible with the transition maps. At each
finite stage (Push) is an isomorphism ([lem-sfb-subfield-push-iso]). Since filtered colimits of
modules are exact, on the $q$-th cohomology sheaves (Push) for $E\subseteq\Qlb$ is therefore
identified with the canonical map

$$
\operatorname{colim}_FR^qf_*(F_X\otimes_{E_X}K^\bullet)\longrightarrow
R^qf_*\operatorname{colim}_F(F_X\otimes_{E_X}K^\bullet).
$$

As $f$ is proper, it is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the complexes have the common lower
bound $a$, so this map is an isomorphism by [sk-cor-pe-bounded-continuity]. Hence (Push) at $K$
is an isomorphism on all cohomology sheaves, so an isomorphism. The common lower bound is
essential: for unbounded complexes $Rf_*$ need not commute with the countable direct sums that
compute $\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}\otimes_{E_X}-$, even for $f$ proper.
